Fixed:

notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2

notes.notes:
-The loading bar will now correctly reflect the loading time and will not appear to have frozen.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6
notes.notes: New main menu indicator

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.notes: More space to arrange the mini models

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- Some parts could not be painted.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes: Improved performance of mini models to reduce lag and loading time on the main menu.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes:
[b]Added:[/b]
- "Choose the next model" button for you to pick upcoming models

[b]Fixed:[/b]
- HexCode bug on paint mode when typing letter e or other shortcut
- Discord button working properly
- Some pieces did not join where they should (maybe some are missing)

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes: Colors now save when closing the game after completing the model.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Colors of the models in the main menu match the one made.
If you have completed the models before this patch, you need to complete them again to save the colors. Remember there was no "save the colors" before.
Have fun

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Eyedropper and paint shortcut keys added (A and S) for easy painting.
[*] The basic tools(drag, cut, decals, paint, manual) now display the shortcut keys to use them.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
- In kitbash mode the model will now appear with its main parts (head, body, arm and legs) separated for better manipulation. 
Buttons will soon be added so that each main part can be chosen individually and the entire model does not appear if it is not necessary.

[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Some parts could not be painted.
- Some texts scaled incorrectly
- Some pieces did not join where they should (maybe some are missing)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Restore you old save
notes.notes: A button has been added to the main menu that takes you to a link with simple instructions to recover your progress in the game restarted by patch 1.0.3.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
To soon implement:  
-A save system in kitbash mode.
-A system for saving colors of the models in the empty room to match the finished one.
-Be able to test the implementation of the Workshop.
-And more.
I had to implement a new save system that resets the progress you have made in the game.
Unfortunately, the save system I started with was not designed with these points in mind, which I know everyone wants to see incorporated into the game.

I apologize for the inconvenience, but with this new system the game will be able to expand for anything else. And I promise that your progress will never be reset again.

Due to these inconveniences, I will add +10 models to the free DLC that will be released later, now being a total of 20-25 new models.

Also:
-Snap of some pieces fixed (probably I'm missing some)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Icons when buttons cannot be used have been implemented so there is no confusion.
[*] Snap of pieces fixed (probably I'm missing some)
[*] Time in timetrial mode adjusted to be more easy.
[*] Timetrial achievement remove, this is because even now it's easier, I don't want the player to stress over getting it. This goes against the relaxing theme of the game, I will still implement an in-game reward if you complete it later. Hmm, probably a special trophy in the empty room or something.
[/list]

Have fun

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New button to open the photo folder in photo mode.
[*] The parts of the models that were reported to me were corrected so that the seam lines are not visible.
[*] Snap of pieces fixed (probably I'm missing some)
[*] Minor bugs on some model fixed: color pallet were not working and decal panel were not showing 
[/list]

Have fun
